summary: PRIMARY BUG FIXED & VERIFIED: Front Porch PIN gate correctly unlocks the dashboard on /@adriana (1984), /@miller (2024), /@lofi-nest (1234) via keypad entry; wrong PIN (0000) shows 'Incorrect PIN' error and stays on porch. Also verified the quick 'Tap for Guest PIN (1984)' button unlock on /@adriana. After unlock, dashboard shows Home, Family Albums, Thoughts tabs plus modules (Scripture, Recipes, Daily Planner, Family Albums). Backend pytest: 15/15 passing (added parametrized GET verify-pin tests for all 3 tenants + wrong-PIN 401 cases). Stripe E2E: Subscribe form (sanctuary-name-input, slug-input, owner-email-input, family-pin-input, continue-to-theme-btn, subscribe-launch-btn) works; POST /api/payments/checkout returns 200 with valid Stripe hosted checkout URL ($40/yr, correct metadata including slug); GET /api/payments/status/{sid} returns pending with correct slug in metadata. Full payment on Stripe hosted page NOT completed — blocked by Stripe sandbox UI (Link forced signup + 'unclaimed sandbox' banner, same as iteration_1).

integration_issues.flow: Stripe hosted checkout payment completion -> /payment/success provisioning
integration_issues.issue: Cannot be driven headlessly: Stripe sandbox page forces Link signup (phone verification) and shows 'unclaimed sandbox' banner. Everything up to the Stripe redirect, and the backend status/provision path, is verified. Needs manual one-click test OR Checkout Session creation with payment_method_types=['card'] to disable Link.

action_items: (Optional) On stripe.checkout.Session.create pass payment_method_types=['card'] to disable Link so automated QA can complete the hosted page.
(Optional) FrontPorchView.handleQuickUnlock() hardcodes '1984'; works only on /@adriana. Low priority since the keypad path works for all tenants.
Main agent can self-test the final Stripe payment completion with one real test-card checkout (30s) — backend _mark_paid provisioning is wired and idempotent.
critical_code_review_comments: FrontPorchView.tsx handleQuickUnlock always uses '1984' instead of the current tenant's PIN (minor; only affects @adriana link anyway).
Firestore unreachable in preview env produces harmless console errors; LocalStorage fallback working as designed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on PIN unlock regression; ~85% on Stripe (redirect + API verified, hosted-page completion blocked by sandbox UI)
